Rules.Description: Recognise flowchart as the flowchart diagram family.
Rules.SuggestedCorrectionTemplate: Recognise graph, flowchart, and flowchart-elk as flowchart-compatible diagram kinds.

Rules.Description: Map symbolic direction tokens to canonical direction values.
Rules.DiagnosticTemplate: Diagram {DiagramId} direction {RawDirection} did not normalise to {ExpectedDirection}.
Rules.SuggestedCorrectionTemplate: Map TD to TB and symbolic direction tokens to canonical TB, BT, LR, or RL.

Rules.Description: Repeated vertex declarations merge into one node contract with deterministic effective properties.
Rules.DiagnosticTemplate: Node {NodeId} was declared {DeclarationCount} times without merging into one contract.
Rules.SuggestedCorrectionTemplate: Merge repeated node declarations into a single node contract.

Rules.Description: Mermaid node syntax and metadata shapes map to canonical shape intent.
Rules.DiagnosticTemplate: Node {NodeId} shape source {ShapeSource} did not map to canonical shape {ExpectedShape}.
Rules.SuggestedCorrectionTemplate: Map Mermaid node syntax and metadata shapes to canonical shape intent.

Rules.Description: Edge token decomposes into stroke, marker start, marker end, directionality, and minlen.
Rules.DiagnosticTemplate: Edge {EdgeId} link token {LinkToken} did not decompose into stroke and marker facts.
Rules.SuggestedCorrectionTemplate: Decompose the edge token into stroke, arrow start, arrow end, directionality, and min length.

Rules.Description: Chained edge statements expand to separate logical edges.
Rules.DiagnosticTemplate: Edge expression for {EdgeId} was not expanded into individual logical edges.
Rules.SuggestedCorrectionTemplate: Expand chained and grouped edge expressions into separate logical edges.

Rules.Description: Minlen is derived from link stroke length, not edge label width.
Rules.DiagnosticTemplate: Edge {EdgeId} min length was influenced by label width instead of the link token.
Rules.SuggestedCorrectionTemplate: Derive MinLength only from the link token hyphen count.

Rules.Description: Subgraph creates a group contract and membership list.
Rules.DiagnosticTemplate: Group {GroupId} has ambiguous or duplicated subgraph membership.
Rules.SuggestedCorrectionTemplate: Assign each node to one effective parent group with deterministic nested ownership.

Rules.Description: style directive mutates the target element style contract.
Rules.DiagnosticTemplate: Diagram {DiagramId} lost style mutation {MutationKind} for target {TargetId}.
Rules.SuggestedCorrectionTemplate: Preserve style, classDef, class, linkStyle, and inline class mutations in the recognition contract.

Rules.Description: Recognised but unsupported constructs must emit diagnostics.
Rules.DiagnosticTemplate: Diagram {DiagramId} contains unsupported construct {ConstructKind} without a diagnostic.
Rules.SuggestedCorrectionTemplate: Emit a structured diagnostic for every recognised but unsupported construct.

Rules.Description: Every rendered node has non-empty bounds and centre co-ordinates.
Rules.DiagnosticTemplate: Node {NodeId} is rendered without complete bounds or centre co-ordinates.
Rules.SuggestedCorrectionTemplate: Assign non-empty bounds and centre co-ordinates to every rendered node.

Rules.Description: Every connected node has rank and lane assignment.
Rules.DiagnosticTemplate: Connected node {NodeId} is missing rank or lane assignment.
Rules.SuggestedCorrectionTemplate: Assign rank and lane values to every connected node in the layout model.

Rules.Description: For primary-flow edges, source and target ordering matches diagram direction.
Rules.DiagnosticTemplate: Primary-flow edge {EdgeId} ordering conflicts with diagram direction {Direction}.
Rules.SuggestedCorrectionTemplate: Ensure primary-flow source and target ordering follows the diagram direction.

Rules.Description: Disconnected single-node components stack on the flow axis in declaration order (F12 LR, F82 TD).
Rules.DiagnosticTemplate: Diagram {DiagramId} disconnected nodes are not stacked on the flow axis in declaration order.
Rules.SuggestedCorrectionTemplate: Pack disconnected single-node components along the diagram flow axis in source declaration order.

Rules.Description: Above/below/left/right/aligned neighbour facts match node centres and direction.
Rules.DiagnosticTemplate: Node {NodeId} neighbour fact {NeighbourFact} conflicts with centre positions.
Rules.SuggestedCorrectionTemplate: Reconcile neighbour facts with node centre positions and diagram direction.

Rules.Description: Unrelated node bodies must not overlap beyond tolerance.
Rules.DiagnosticTemplate: Node {NodeId} overlaps unrelated node {OtherNodeId} beyond tolerance.
Rules.SuggestedCorrectionTemplate: Adjust layout so unrelated node bodies do not overlap beyond tolerance.

Rules.Description: A group member must lie within its group bounds, allowing configured padding.
Rules.DiagnosticTemplate: Node {NodeId} lies outside parent group {GroupId} bounds.
Rules.SuggestedCorrectionTemplate: Contain group members within group bounds using configured padding.

Rules.Description: Sibling subgraph cluster boxes must maintain a minimum exterior gap on the primary flow axis (24px, including padding and title band clearance).
Rules.DiagnosticTemplate: Subgraph {GroupId} is too close to a sibling subgraph on the primary flow axis.
Rules.SuggestedCorrectionTemplate: Increase spacing between sibling subgraph cluster boxes so the exterior gap is at least 24px on the flow axis.

Rules.Description: External nodes linked across a subgraph boundary must maintain a minimum gap from the cluster box on the primary flow axis (24px, including padding and title band clearance).
Rules.DiagnosticTemplate: Subgraph {GroupId} is too close to an external node on the primary flow axis.
Rules.SuggestedCorrectionTemplate: Increase spacing between external nodes and the subgraph cluster box so the exterior gap is at least 24px on the flow axis.

Rules.Description: A nested child subgraph cluster must sit inside its parent cluster box with at least 24px exterior gap on the cross-flow axis and at least rankSpacing (default 50px) on the primary flow axis.
Rules.DiagnosticTemplate: Parent subgraph {GroupId} does not fully contain a nested child cluster with the required exterior gap.
Rules.SuggestedCorrectionTemplate: Expand the parent cluster box so each nested child subgraph border respects the configured cross-flow (24px) and flow-axis (rankSpacing) exterior gaps.

Rules.Description: Direct member nodes in a parent subgraph must maintain at least rankSpacing (default 50px) clearance from nested child subgraph cluster boxes on the primary flow axis.
Rules.DiagnosticTemplate: Parent subgraph {GroupId} places direct member nodes too close to a nested child cluster on the primary flow axis.
Rules.SuggestedCorrectionTemplate: Shift direct member nodes outside nested child cluster boxes so the flow-axis exterior gap is at least rankSpacing.

Rules.Description: Adjacent-rank primary-flow edges should use primary centre exit/entry and avoid unnecessary detours.
Rules.SuggestedCorrectionTemplate: Satisfy the structural behaviour expected for the inferred route class without fixture-specific special cases.

Rules.Description: Simple adjacent-node edges should be direct or softly curved according to configured curve.
Rules.SuggestedCorrectionTemplate: Satisfy the structural behaviour expected for the inferred route class without fixture-specific special cases.

Rules.Description: Decision branches should leave from distinct appropriate boundary regions and keep labels attached to branches.
Rules.SuggestedCorrectionTemplate: Satisfy the structural behaviour expected for the inferred route class without fixture-specific special cases.

Rules.Description: One-to-many routing should distribute branches without collapsing unrelated paths.
Rules.SuggestedCorrectionTemplate: Satisfy the structural behaviour expected for the inferred route class without fixture-specific special cases.

Rules.Description: Many-to-one routing should merge cleanly at a target without ambiguous visual collapse.
Rules.SuggestedCorrectionTemplate: Satisfy the structural behaviour expected for the inferred route class without fixture-specific special cases.

Rules.Description: Parallel or branch paths merging back to a downstream node should form clear merge-back routes.
Rules.SuggestedCorrectionTemplate: Satisfy the structural behaviour expected for the inferred route class without fixture-specific special cases.

Rules.Description: Rank-spanning or exception edges use an exterior or obstacle-aware corridor.
Rules.SuggestedCorrectionTemplate: Satisfy the structural behaviour expected for the inferred route class without fixture-specific special cases.

Rules.Description: Back/return edges should route around the primary flow without crossing node bodies.
Rules.SuggestedCorrectionTemplate: Satisfy the structural behaviour expected for the inferred route class without fixture-specific special cases.

Rules.Description: Primary-flow edges leave and enter via direction-appropriate ports.
Rules.DiagnosticTemplate: Edge {EdgeId} uses ports {SourcePort}->{TargetPort} that conflict with direction {Direction}.
Rules.SuggestedCorrectionTemplate: Select source and target ports appropriate to the diagram primary direction.

Rules.Description: Multiple decision branches should fan out without branch/label ambiguity.
Rules.DiagnosticTemplate: Decision node {SourceNodeId} branches use conflicting source ports.
Rules.SuggestedCorrectionTemplate: Assign distinct or non-conflicting source boundary regions to decision branches.

Rules.Description: Nodes with multiple incoming edges require distinct entry handling and collision avoidance.
Rules.DiagnosticTemplate: Merge target {TargetNodeId} incoming edges do not have separable entry regions.
Rules.SuggestedCorrectionTemplate: Separate merge entry regions or merge points for multiple incoming edges.

Rules.Description: Edges terminate at rendered shape boundaries rather than node centres.
Rules.DiagnosticTemplate: Edge {EdgeId} terminates at node centre instead of shape boundary.
Rules.SuggestedCorrectionTemplate: Terminate edges at rendered shape boundary intersections.

Rules.Description: Visible edge endpoints meet the rendered shape boundary (shape-specific ray exit), not a padded bbox centre.
Rules.DiagnosticTemplate: Edge {EdgeId} does not terminate on the visible shape boundary.
Rules.SuggestedCorrectionTemplate: Terminate the connector at the shape-specific boundary intersection used by the renderer.

Rules.Description: Every visible connector leaves and enters node faces at right angles through perpendicular terminal stubs on both layout guides and rendered strokes.
Rules.DiagnosticTemplate: Edge {EdgeId} does not attach perpendicular to the rendered node boundary.
Rules.SuggestedCorrectionTemplate: Adjust the rendered route so terminal stubs are perpendicular to the joined node face.

Rules.Description: Rendered corridor, bypass, fan-in/out, and decision connectors must not contain visible kinks, hooks, or hard elbows in the curved body.
Rules.DiagnosticTemplate: Edge {EdgeId} contains a visible kink in the rendered smooth path.
Rules.SuggestedCorrectionTemplate: Simplify guide points or corridor curves so the rendered stroke eases smoothly into terminal stubs.

Rules.Description: Rendered node labels are centred horizontally within the node body.
Rules.SuggestedCorrectionTemplate: Centre the node label horizontally within the node bounds in FlowchartSugiyamaSvgRenderer.

Rules.Description: Rendered node labels are centred vertically within the node body.
Rules.SuggestedCorrectionTemplate: Centre the node label vertically within the node bounds in FlowchartSugiyamaSvgRenderer.

Rules.Description: Legacy trapezoid bracket delimiters render as slanted bracket paths with correct width asymmetry (F81/F82), not axis-aligned rectangles.
Rules.DiagnosticTemplate: Node {NodeId} legacy bracket shape {Shape} did not render with correct trapezoid bracket geometry.
Rules.SuggestedCorrectionTemplate: Render [/label/], [/label \], [\label/], and [\label \] using the matching slanted bracket path builder, not a rectangle.

Rules.Description: Cross endpoint markers keep a small exterior stand-off from the shape boundary; all other markers terminate on the boundary.
Rules.SuggestedCorrectionTemplate: Apply the cross-marker exterior gap only to cross endpoints; other markers must meet the boundary.

Rules.Description: Adjacent-rank primary-flow edges should use primary centre exit/entry and avoid unnecessary detours.
Rules.SuggestedCorrectionTemplate: Adjust the route path to satisfy the required path-shape constraint.

Rules.Description: Orthogonal routing expects axis-aligned segments with legal rounded/clean corners.
Rules.SuggestedCorrectionTemplate: Adjust the route path to satisfy the required path-shape constraint.

Rules.Description: Polyline routing expects segmented non-spline edge paths without illegal node intersections.
Rules.SuggestedCorrectionTemplate: Adjust the route path to satisfy the required path-shape constraint.

Rules.Description: Default curveBasis diagrams must not render multi-segment orthogonal edge polylines (F58 terminal collector, bypass, and fan-in routes use smooth corridor curves).

Rules.Description: Route does not reverse direction immediately after leaving source.
Rules.SuggestedCorrectionTemplate: Adjust the route path to satisfy the required path-shape constraint.

Rules.Description: Route does not overshoot and hook into target.
Rules.SuggestedCorrectionTemplate: Adjust the route path to satisfy the required path-shape constraint.

Rules.Description: Edges must avoid unrelated node bodies and cluster bodies.
Rules.SuggestedCorrectionTemplate: Adjust the route path to satisfy the required path-shape constraint.

Rules.Description: Edges must avoid unrelated node bodies and cluster bodies.
Rules.DiagnosticTemplate: Edge {EdgeId} crosses node {IntersectedNodeId}. Route the edge around the node body.
Rules.SuggestedCorrectionTemplate: Move the route into an available corridor and preserve the source/target ports and marker intent.

Rules.Description: Edge does not pass through unrelated cluster bodies or confusing group interiors.
Rules.SuggestedCorrectionTemplate: Route around unrelated cluster bodies and avoid confusing group interiors.

Rules.Description: Decision branches should leave from distinct appropriate boundary regions and keep labels attached to branches.
Rules.DiagnosticTemplate: Sibling branches from {SourceNodeId} cross each other unnecessarily.
Rules.SuggestedCorrectionTemplate: Separate sibling decision branch corridors to avoid unnecessary crossings.

Rules.Description: Long exception routes avoid cutting through the centre spine corridor unless structurally required.
Rules.DiagnosticTemplate: Exception edge {EdgeId} cuts through the centre spine corridor.
Rules.SuggestedCorrectionTemplate: Route long exception paths in an exterior corridor and avoid the centre spine unless structurally required.

Rules.Description: Edge labels require clearance and must remain visually attached to the owning edge.
Rules.SuggestedCorrectionTemplate: Adjust label placement to satisfy label routing constraints.
